Level 1

Match 4 for a cue ball (clears a row) or 5 for chalk (clears row and column). Stripes +8. 8-balls are wild.

How to play

    Pocket Match

    Match 3+ balls of a colour. Each ball scores its number × 10, and rare black 8-balls are wild and double the match.
